pre_execution_questions.question: How to validate domain and pinned references without reopening intake paths?
pre_execution_questions.proposal: Bounded schema/identity/Asset/intent checks on held snapshot; targeted accepted-history adapter and iterative current-package graph checks; replay before fresh-command duplicate/history validation. Original static helper remains reference, not runtime pipeline.

pre_execution_questions.question: How to classify a timeout or unknown COMMIT outcome?
pre_execution_questions.proposal: Separate client UNKNOWN/retryable/IO/cancel states from the six canonical receipt statuses; recover exact retained transaction/hash before deciding success/safe retry. No new producer IDs or receipt enum changes.

pre_execution_questions.question: What prevents incremental BLOB mutation of accepted rows when immutable SQL UPDATE triggers do not?
pre_execution_questions.why: Real native probe with defensive mode changed an accepted BLOB through blobopen, while SQL UPDATE was rejected. This is trusted-writer authority, not proof of an incoming exploit.
pre_execution_questions.proposal: Importer keeps connection/row IDs private and opens writable BLOBs only for newly inserted current-command rows; read/replay expose read-only access. Explicit negative regression required, not relying on trigger immutability for blob API.

acceptance_checks.check: New private synthetic DB only; verify candidate physical v1 tables/constraints/headers, SQLite>=3.37, DELETE/EXTRA, foreign_keys=ON, trusted_schema=OFF and supported defensive configuration. Unknown existing format rejected without initialization/mutation; interrupted new initialization not accepted.

Consume only live verified snapshot bytes; no original-path reopen or producer-forged readiness object. R1 supports independent_save and four R1 types only; tracked_research/Source/Run and unsupported schema reject. Validate strict bounded operation-document identity, schemas, provenance, pinned refs and every required byte limit. For each Asset bytes storage, bind safe declared file_path, exact measured length/hash and retained commit mapping to this package inventory; locator mode stores metadata only and never fetches. New-command references resolve against relevant retained history under writer lock; wrong-object/type/missing revision rejects without canonical changes.

Under BEGIN IMMEDIATE perform exact transaction/hash lookup before CAS AND before fresh-command duplicate/history-dependent validation. Verified unchanged incoming snapshot plus verified original retained commit/bytes/receipt => REPLAY with original canonical IDs, zero writes, even after head changed; no accepted+identical-new-docs duplicate validation. Changed hash => transaction conflict. For new transaction check reused revision IDs, object type/base ownership/current heads and resolve relevant refs; any stale operation conflicts and rolls back whole command. Lock BUSY is bounded retryable, never conflict/accepted.

One transaction retains exact READY/manifest/policy/original BLOB bytes, all revisions and original ACCEPTED receipt with app-generated attempt/commit IDs/sequence. Writable incremental BLOB handles are private and restricted to files inserted by this active transaction; producer cannot choose a file_id/table/column/DB path. Stream bounded bytes/hash, close BLOB handles before commit; no UPDATE/REPLACE/delete or writable BLOB handle for accepted rows. Public read/replay use read-only handles/connections. No partial success or replacement of previous canonical receipt by failed attempt; validate receipt schemas/fields and bounded diagnostic totals.

Inject owned copy/BLOB/I-O/ENOSPC failures and terminate only owned children before/after commit and before receipt return. Reopen establishes zero or one canonical commit; retain receipt/original bytes or report integrity error; never delete rollback journals manually. Test bounded lock budget/unknown outcome and exact safe retry. Keep client UNKNOWN, retryable/BUSY, cancellation and IO outcomes separate from protocol receipt enum; never persist UNKNOWN/BUSY/IO_ERROR as an unsupported canonical receipt status or reinterpret them as INCOMPLETE/success. Fresh retry keeps producer IDs/bytes.

Read-only receipt/original recovery from DB after source changes/removal; byte/hash identity, immutable history and head derivation. Multi-object acceptance/replay/conflict and parent-child reference cases use real supported R1 fixtures. Do not conflate transport-only success with ACCEPTED/REPLAY. Negative cases cover valid document/attachment transport with mismatched Asset metadata; supported-looking tracked_research command in R1; replay with original revisions already in retained history; corrupted retained BLOB on replay/read; and refusal of app writes to an old BLOB. No complete unbounded SELECT file_blob/history materialization.

Record native SQLite/Python/configuration, per-case expected/actual outcomes, issue open/resolved history, source/baseline/readback guards and precise scope. Mandatory unavailable cases NOT_VERIFIED block completion; no live Bank/UI/hardware power-off/production or R0/R1 gate acceptance.

Bound historical work independently of total Bank size: indexed targeted ID/head/ref lookups, length preflight and streaming BLOB integrity; schema-validated incoming graph handled iteratively (<=128 operations under existing policy), never recursive DFS through all accepted history or loading every historical document/BLOB. A >1000-revision valid accepted causal chain must not trigger recursion failure for one independent save or a pinned-history lookup. Preserve reference/cycle/type checks and original integrity; if a required proof/read cannot be bounded or performed, return explicit non-success and keep canonical state unchanged, not silent acceptance/partial validation.

execution_sequence.rule: Obtain and hold actual secure reader snapshot, not a manifest/status assertion; immutable handoff lifetime covers copy.
Check supported R1 intent/types, operation-document schema/identity, Asset-to-package binding and incoming byte/graph constraints without full-history loads.
BEGIN IMMEDIATE, bounded exact transaction lookup. Same hash uses stored integrity/receipt replay branch before new-command duplicate/history/CAS checks; different hash conflicts.

For new transaction, targeted retained revision/type/head/ref lookups; verify consumed stored documents/bytes, enforce base ownership/type stability/current-head CAS and in-package causal cycles iteratively.
Only newly inserted file row IDs receive writable BLOB handles; verify bytes, close all handles, write original receipt, explicit COMMIT. No accepted result before confirmed success.
Reopen/query retained commit for unknown outcomes; release snapshot after consumption, preserve originals/diagnostics and exact safe retry IDs.

history_validation_strategy.strategy: Do not reuse validate_documents(accepted=all_history) as runtime architecture. Reuse pure schema/ref rules with explicit bounded targeted history adapter. Accepted rows are immutable validated facts within trusted app-owned DB; verify relevant retained document/BLOB metadata/digests when read. Keep complete retained history on disk; avoiding full memory load is not pruning history.
history_validation_strategy.cycle_argument: After revision-ID reuse check, previously accepted commands could not reference unknown future revisions; immutable accepted causal history cannot point back into newly proposed IDs. Check all new-package causal edges iteratively; references to retained revisions need bounded integrity/identity checks. Do not rely on this argument for foreign/unknown DB formats or migrated data without accepted provenance.
history_validation_strategy.no_new_acceptance_shortcut: This strategy is a proposal; DB8 must demonstrate its guarantees in implementation. If unable to verify relevant state, fail explicitly and document the limitation.

receipt_outcome_boundary.rule: Client/attempt outcomes are separate wrapper/log fields, not additional canonical receipt enum values. Attempt diagnostics never overwrite accepted receipt. Recovery cannot infer failed commit from mere receipt absence/exception.

preimplementation_review.note: Five actual native counterexamples establish helper/API boundaries. No importer implementation or DB1-DB8 PASS claimed; source contracts/static tooling/accepted baseline preserved.
